probe_policy.purpose: tiny Responses transport/accounting capability gate before any further 80K-class Sol benchmark request
probe_policy.usage_discovery: recursively search nested response objects for input/prompt and output/completion token counters instead of assuming only top-level/data/response/result usage
probe_policy.missing_usage_behavior: stop before the full benchmark call, mark spend UNKNOWN/unreconciled, and retain only safe key structure/request identifiers; never invent token measurements

accounting_policy.successful_live_envelope: record exact recursively discovered usage and estimated cost before visible-final-text parsing
accounting_policy.probe_without_discoverable_usage: do not proceed to the full benchmark call
accounting_policy.api_error_without_usage: retain sanitized type/code/param/status only and fail; do not retain provider message or reasoning

scope: freeze and reuse all four existing scored observations; issue only a tiny Sol Responses probe first; proceed to the full Sol benchmark request in the same run only if exact token usage is discoverable; never repurchase Qwen, GLM, DeepSeek or Kimi for this transport repair
architecture_snapshot_policy: retain the same canonical ACCB-DEV-001 snapshot used by the first four scores so a later fifth score remains directly comparable; A/B/C/D expansion is a later preregistered tranche
provider_policy: pin the OpenAI endpoint tag; allow_fallbacks=false; record actual provider metadata returned by RouterAI
transport_policy: GPT-5.6 Sol follows the live endpoint-declared Responses transport; only visible final-answer fields may become candidate output; provider reasoning/thinking is never retained
admission_policy: Sol must expose a healthy Responses endpoint >=128K and positive parseable pricing; the existing <=100 RUB upper bound remains, but the tiny probe additionally gates whether the expensive live request is permitted at all
scientific_boundary: fifth-model low-context calibration/integration evidence only; no universal ECC/AMCE threshold inference
